factual_methodological.summary: Revision 1 checks the ISM headline and components against the 1 October manufacturing release; nominal and real Treasury yields against U.S. Treasury/Federal Reserve data; euro-area unemployment against Eurostat; propane export volumes, route shifts and constraints against EIA; and upcoming U.S. release dates against BLS.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: The argument now advances through demand, inventories, input prices, long-duration financing, European labour and energy-trade transmission. It distinguishes observation from inference, includes explicit falsifiers and avoids stitched release-by-release prose.

novelty_against_previous_daily.summary: The revision replaces the generic 'dispersion' conclusion with a causal macro thesis: U.S. factory demand is resilient, but input prices and high nominal/real long yields raise the cost of converting orders into output and capacity.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: 1 Markdown table + 2 explicit charts + 1 causal flow + 1 trade-route map per locale
visual_evidence_readiness.summary: All quantitative visuals use values reproduced from cited primary sources; EN/PT-BR visuals are semantically equivalent; structural arrows and route statements are qualified in the prose.

political_neutrality.summary: Policy and trade effects are described factually without endorsing, opposing, scoring or ranking political actors or choices.

contrary_evidence: The headline ISM Manufacturing PMI edged down 0.1 point and Production fell 1.6 points, so the data do not establish broad manufacturing acceleration.
The 10-year Treasury yield fell from 5.29% on 30 September to 5.24% on 1 October, so the financing argument is about the high level of long rates rather than a same-day tightening.
Euro-area unemployment was unchanged month on month and youth unemployment declined slightly from July, limiting claims of abrupt European labour deterioration.
U.S. propane exports to China fell 19% year on year in the first half of 2026 and export/logistics capacity can constrain continued aggregate growth.
limitations: The ISM PMI and its components are diffusion indexes, not direct manufacturing-output growth rates.
The ISM Prices Index is not CPI, PPI or PCE and should not be treated as a direct forecast of consumer inflation.
Treasury yields reflect multiple expectations and risk premia; the report does not attribute their level to a single cause.
Eurostat unemployment data refer to August and lag the 1 October publication date.
Propane export evidence covers the first half of 2026 and therefore represents a structural trade channel rather than a same-day demand indicator.
The causal chain connecting orders, input costs, financing and investment is an analytical transmission mechanism, not proof of firm-level causality.
notes: Revision 1 approved after source re-verification, argument-continuity review, bilingual parity review, visual-semantic review and explicit falsifier/limitation checks.

en.title: Global Macro — U.S. factory demand strengthens as input inflation and long yields raise the cost of expansion
en.deck: U.S. factory demand strengthened, but ISM Prices rose to 77.9 and the 10-year Treasury stayed above 5%; Europe softened while propane exports hit records.
en.regime: Costly resilience: U.S. manufacturing demand remains expansionary, but input-price pressure and high real and nominal long-term yields raise the cost of converting orders into capacity and output.
en.key_risk: If restocking and order growth persist while input prices and long real yields remain elevated, margins, working capital and investment can tighten even without a fall in headline activity.

pt-BR.deck: A demanda industrial dos EUA ganhou força, mas Preços ISM foi a 77,9 e o Treasury de 10 anos seguiu acima de 5%; Europa suavizou e propano bateu recordes.
pt-BR.regime: Resiliência cara: a demanda industrial dos EUA continua expansionista, mas a pressão de preços dos insumos e os juros reais e nominais longos elevados aumentam o custo de converter pedidos em capacidade e produção.
